title: GTA 6 radio: Bad Bunny and Lana Del Rey are DJs 📻
subject: gta6
description:
Which GTA 6 station are you tuning into first? 👇

On October 8, 2026, Rockstar previewed 6 GTA 6 radio stations on its official music page: Flash FM, Back Country Radio, Cocoteo FM, The Chamber 106.6, AfroBank FM and Dirty South Classics, with hosts including Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey, Morgan Wallen and Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya. For the first time, players can listen on foot through Jason and Lucia's phones. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Rockstar Games GTA VI music page (Oct 8, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 8, 2026), Forbes (Oct 8, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Bad Bunny is a radio DJ in GTA 6.
On October 8, Rockstar previewed 6 of the game's stations, and you can listen right now.
Bad Bunny hosts Cocoteo FM, the Latin station.
Lana Del Rey and Morgan Wallen host the country station, while Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya run the metal one.
And for the first time, you can listen on foot, through Jason and Lucia's phones.
